messages:
alex_support: Customer report - streaming responses from Node SDK on edge runtime (Vercel) hang after ~20-30s, sometimes followed by 401s. They say billing shows token spikes when it retries. Repro steps attached below. Can we triage? :warning:

alex_support: repro summary:
1) Using nextjs edge function with @redwood-inference/sdk@0.3.0
2) call to `client.chat.stream()` returns a ReadableStream but stream stops emitting after ~25s with no error
3) subsequent fetch retry from client shows 401 on /v1/responses (same token)
4) billing dashboard shows multiple small token bursts at the same time window

alex_support: minimal server code they used:
```js
import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk';
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
export default async function handler(req) {
  const stream = await client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood/fast-1', input: 'stream test' });
  return new Response(stream.body, { status: 200 });
}
```

jia_eng: Thanks, adding details. First guess: known edge runtime ReadableStream closing bug with SDK 0.3.0 where the auth header can be dropped on internal retry if a redirect/containerized fetch occurs. Could explain the 401 after hang. Also retries are aggressive which can double-charge token reporting in billing system (we saw similar in 0.2.x).

sam_devex: @jia_eng do we have a quick fix we can ask the customer to try?

jia_eng: Ask them to pin SDK to 0.3.3 (contains the auth-retry fix) or apply this workaround: set maximum retries to 0 and proxy streaming from server (avoid edge-to-edge double fetch). Example workaround:
```js
// workaround: disable client-side retries in edge env
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, maxRetries: 0, edge: true });
```

alex_support: Customer tried 0.3.3 in prod and confirmed stream seems stable for longer but still saw one 401 when they scaled up concurrent streams. They also provided an error snippet from their Vercel logs:
```
ERR_STREAM_CLOSED: ReadableStream suddenly closed during pipeTo
fetch: request failed: 401 Unauthorized (request-id: req_01F2XQZ9)
```

jia_eng: Request-id is perfect, can we get full request headers for that req id? Also please ask them to run with DEBUG=rw:network to capture internal retry trace. I'll check the routing layer for any re-auth attempts.

maria_billing: From billing side - token accounting looks like repeated small bursts around that timestamp, but I don't see doubled invoice charges yet. The spikes match retry windows. If retries are suppressed we should see normalization. We will hold escalation on billing if engineering confirms retry bug.

alex_support: Sent instructions to customer (pin 0.3.3, set maxRetries:0, enable DEBUG). They ran and returned logs with the debug trace showing `internal-retry attempt=1 dropped-auth=true` right before the 401. Attached small excerpt.

jia_eng: That confirms it. Root cause: internal fetch retry path didn't reattach Authorization header for streaming proxy flows on edge fetch redirect. Fix is staged (PR #3421) and will be included in next 0.3.4 patch. Short-term: recommend 0.3.3 + maxRetries:0 for edge. Medium-term: we'll roll 0.3.4 and patch routing.

sam_devex: I'll post a KB note in docs/known-issues and update the support playbook with the repro + workaround steps.

alex_support: Customer is happy to test 0.3.4 when released. For now they confirmed stability after disabling retries. Closing the loop with them. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2145 assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P2.
